blocks.title: Wing doubled overnight · eight new surfaces in the chamber
blocks.dek: Mike: 'more on nouns, alters, shrines, meditatives, plan then build' → 'ok keep going' → 'more alters, shrines, prayer areas, not to existing for this pass, very 2026, colors, audios, visuals, results, presence, peace, pace, flow.' Two waves shipped: a meditative quintet (shrine, rosary, koan, prayer-flag, mantra) and a very-2026 trio (aurora, lantern, bath). The wing went from 13 surfaces to 21.
